```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(hdrm)
```

```{r}
generate_data <- function(n, rho) {
  hdrm::gen_data(
    n = n,
    p = 20,
    p1 = 5,
    beta = c(seq(1/6, 5/6, by = 1/6), rep(0, 15)),
    family = "gaussian",
    signam = "heterogeneous",
    corr = "exchangeable",
    rho = rho
  )
}
# Usage: 
# set.seed(2025)
# for (i in 1:10000) {
#   dat <- generate_data(n = 250, rho = 0.35)
#   # run selection methods...
# }

```
